content.text: The preview matches the target closely. Exporting.

I built the hex bolt, exported it to `submission.step`, and its four preview views line up with `composite.png`.

- **Head:** a hexagon 16 mm across the flats and 7.5 mm tall, at the top (+Z).
- **Shank:** a plain cylinder 10.5 mm across and 28 mm long, running along Z.
- **Overall size:** 18.5 × 16 × 35.5 mm. It is one valid solid, and reading the STEP file back gave the same volume and box as the part.

I took the proportions from the reference image by eye, so they are approximate. My first attempt had a longer shank (35 mm) and a shorter head (7 mm), and I adjusted both after comparing the preview with the target.

I left the threads off and modelled the shank as a smooth cylinder. They change very little of the volume, so they should barely affect the voxel score.

You can watch the part in the live viewer at http://127.0.0.1:8773/#part.FCStd.
